question: In what ways is the divine revered and consulted by gods and asuras?
premises: The one saluted by gods and asuras receives salutation as a divine form.
The great counsellor of gods and asuras receives salutation as a divine form.
inference: The divine commands universal reverence and serves as the supreme guide for all beings.
plain_english: Salutation to the one saluted by gods and asuras, salutation to the great counsellor of gods and asuras.
